title: Not like I thought it would be.
text: Not like I thought it would be.. These seem to be well made but the mist isn't fine.  Its just a spray.  Dosen't compare to the Misto spray where you can pump it an put the oil under pressure.  I don't like to use aerosol sprays and was looking for a replacement for my broken Misto sprayer..
